name: M4 in Markdown (injection)
comment: Injected (not just included) so m4 constructs are recognized even in the middle of an already-open Markdown block (e.g. a multi-line paragraph or list item), not only at the start of a line. A plain 'include text.html.markdown' composition can't do that: once Markdown's own paragraph/list/etc. rule has started matching, only *its* nested patterns are considered for the rest of that block - see README.md.
